cast.name: Victor
cast.canonical: a young pale scientist with wild dark hair, feverish eyes

cast.name: the Creature
cast.canonical: a huge very tall figure with patchwork stitched skin, long black hair, deep sad sunken eyes
cast.anchor: a ragged brown cloak and visible stitches

cast.name: Elizabeth
cast.canonical: a gentle young woman with braided hair

panels.scene: an arctic sea of ice, a wooden sailing ship trapped in the frost, Captain Walton on deck spotting an exhausted man on the ice in the distance
panels.composition: wide establishing; figures small on the vast ice

teen.narration: THE FROZEN NORTH. CAPTAIN WALTON’S SHIP IS LOCKED IN ICE WHEN HE HAULS ABOARD A DYING STRANGER — VICTOR FRANKENSTEIN, WHO BEGS TO TELL HIS WARNING OF A TALE.

bubbles.speaker: victor
bubbles.text: LISTEN... BEFORE IT FINDS ME TOO.

panels.scene: a young student in a candle-lit study buried in books and diagrams, dreaming of conquering death, a spark of mad ambition in his eyes

teen.narration: AS A STUDENT, VICTOR BURNED WITH ONE DREAM: TO DEFEAT DEATH ITSELF. WHERE OTHERS SAW A WALL, HE SAW A DOOR.

bubbles.speaker: victor
bubbles.text: WHY SHOULD ANYONE HAVE TO DIE?

teen.quote: Life and death appeared to me ideal bounds, which I should first break through, and pour a torrent of light into our dark world.

panels.scene: a grim workshop at night, the scientist stitching together a large body from parts, jars and instruments everywhere, obsessive and exhausted

teen.narration: FOR NEARLY TWO YEARS HE LABOURED IN SECRET, ROBBING GRAVES AND LABS, STITCHING A BODY FROM THE DEAD. HE FORGOT THE SUN. HE FORGOT HIS FAMILY.
teen.quote: the sole purpose of infusing life into an inanimate body

panels.scene: a stormy rainy midnight, lightning through the window, the scientist at the moment his creation stirs, dramatic and eerie

teen.narration: AND THEN, ONE STORMY NIGHT... IT WORKED.
teen.quote: It was on a dreary night of November that I beheld the accomplishment of my toils

panels.scene: close on the scientist recoiling in horror as the tall stitched Creature opens its watery yellow eyes for the first time
panels.composition: medium two-shot; Victor recoiling, Creature dim behind

teen.narration: BUT THE INSTANT IT LIVED, VICTOR’S DREAM CURDLED INTO NIGHTMARE. THE THING HE’D IMAGINED BEAUTIFUL WAS... HORRIBLE.
teen.quote: the beauty of the dream vanished, and breathless horror and disgust filled my heart

panels.scene: the scientist running away down a dark street, abandoning the confused newborn Creature who reaches out a hand, alone and bewildered
panels.composition: medium; Victor fleeing foreground, Creature small behind reaching out

teen.narration: SO THE MAKER RAN. HE LEFT HIS CREATION ALONE, MINUTES OLD, IN A COLD AND HOSTILE WORLD. THAT CHOICE WOULD COST HIM EVERYTHING.

panels.scene: the Creature hidden in a shed, secretly watching a poor family through a crack, teaching himself to read by candlelight, lonely but gentle

teen.narration: ALONE, THE CREATURE TAUGHT HIMSELF TO SPEAK AND READ BY SPYING ON A KIND FAMILY. HE WASN’T A MONSTER YET — JUST LONELY, AND HOPING TO BE LOVED.

bubbles.speaker: creature
bubbles.text: MAYBE THEY WILL BE MY FRIENDS...

panels.scene: villagers with torches and sticks screaming and driving away the frightened Creature, who shields his face, rejected and heartbroken
panels.composition: wide; mob small and spread, Creature at edge

teen.narration: BUT EVERYONE WHO SAW HIS FACE SCREAMED AND ATTACKED. LOVED BY NO ONE, JUDGED ONLY BY HIS LOOKS, HIS HOPE ROTTED INTO RAGE.
teen.quote: I ought to be thy Adam, but I am rather the fallen angel, whom thou drivest from joy for no misdeed

panels.scene: on a misty glacier high in the mountains, the towering Creature confronts the small scientist face to face, tense and sorrowful
panels.composition: medium two-shot; kept at conversational distance

teen.narration: AT LAST THE CREATURE HUNTS DOWN HIS MAKER ON A MOUNTAIN OF ICE. HE IS NOT SORRY. HE IS ACCUSING.
teen.quote: I am malicious because I am miserable

panels.scene: the Creature towering over the scientist, demanding fiercely, the small man cowering, a fraught standoff

teen.narration: HIS DEMAND: MAKE ME A COMPANION, SOMEONE AS WRETCHED AS ME, SO I NEED NOT BE ALONE. VICTOR REFUSES. THE CREATURE IS DONE ASKING NICELY.
teen.quote: You are my creator, but I am your master; obey!

panels.scene: the scientist tearing apart a half-finished second body in his lab while the Creature watches through the window with fury and grief
panels.composition: medium; Victor foreground, Creature at window

teen.narration: SICKENED, VICTOR DESTROYS THE HALF-MADE MATE. THE CREATURE’S LAST HOPE DIES WITH IT — AND HE SWEARS A CHILLING REVENGE.

bubbles.speaker: creature
bubbles.text: THEN NEITHER OF US WILL BE HAPPY.

teen.quote: I shall be with you on your wedding-night

panels.scene: a wedding night turned to tragedy, the scientist rushing in too late, grief and shadow, a blue shawl on the floor
panels.composition: medium; Victor in grief, Creature's shadow at the door

teen.narration: THE CREATURE KEEPS HIS WORD. ONE BY ONE, EVERYONE VICTOR LOVES IS TAKEN — INCLUDING HIS BRIDE, ELIZABETH. NOW THE MAKER HAS NOTHING LEFT BUT HATE.

bubbles.speaker: victor
bubbles.text: I’LL HUNT YOU TO THE ENDS OF THE EARTH!

panels.scene: a tiny sled and the lone scientist chasing a distant fleeing figure across an endless frozen wasteland, obsession and exhaustion
panels.composition: wide; two tiny figures on the vast ice

teen.narration: MAKER AND MADE CHASE EACH OTHER TO THE TOP OF THE WORLD — EACH LIVING ONLY TO DESTROY THE OTHER. WHICH IS THE REAL MONSTER NOW?

panels.scene: back on Walton's ice-bound ship, the scientist lies dead in a cabin while the towering Creature weeps over him, one huge hand extended, before turning to vanish into the polar dark
panels.composition: wide finale; Creature large but bowed, Walton small in doorway

teen.narration: VICTOR DIES ON THE ICE. AND WALTON FINDS THE CREATURE WEEPING OVER HIS MAKER — NOT TRIUMPHANT, BUT BROKEN. THEN HE STEPS INTO THE DARKNESS, TO END HIMSELF, AND IS SEEN NO MORE.

bubbles.speaker: creature
bubbles.text: HE WAS MY FATHER... AND I NEVER KNEW HIS LOVE.

teen.quote: one vast hand was extended, in colour and apparent texture like that of a mummy
